reviews.author: Rosalind Teoh
reviews.headline: The one you will actually wear out
reviews.body: Black with the deco print catching the light only when you move. Dressed up with heels, dressed down with flats and a denim jacket — it takes both without looking like it is trying.

reviews.author: Fenella Adjei
reviews.headline: Beautiful, but the black shows lint
reviews.body: No complaints about the make or the fit. It is dark silk, so it picks up every stray thread — keep a roller in your bag and it is faultless.
